one_liner: Beacon client app that sends world metadata (URL, name, description, image, tags) to an external relay and periodically heartbeats the session.
primary_use_case: Collects and reports a world's canonical URL, name, description, preview image, and tags to a relay server, then maintains session liveness via periodic heartbeat signals.
preview_recommendation: Add a preview image or model thumbnail to the app's media assets to give users a visual cue, as currently no media is attached.
